AMD Amethyst

Amethyst
Amethyst PRO
E8950
Block Diagram
AMD's Amethyst GPU uses the GCN 3 architecture and is made using a 28 nm production process at TSMC. With a die size of 366 mm² and a transistor count of 5.00 billion it is a large chip. Amethyst supports DirectX 12 (Feature Level 12_0). It also supports OpenGL 4.6 and Vulkan 1.2.170. For GPU compute applications, OpenCL version 2.0 can be used. It features 2048 shading units, 128 texture mapping units and 32 ROPs.
Further reading: GCN 3.0 Instruction Set Architecture
